description: Animated cutscenes for Hypixel SkyBlock's rare drops: your loot stays hidden until the reveal. A Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.2.

mods.name: Butcher
mods.description: Cutscenes for Hypixel SkyBlock's rare drops: the Scatha, Vanguard corpses, the Crystal Nucleus, Diana's Mythological Ritual, the Revenant, Tarantula and Inferno Demonlord slayers, lava fishing, and pop-ups for the Fishing Festival's sharks, the Dwarven Mines' Ghosts, the Automaton, Summoning Eyes and the Garden. The drop is hidden until the reveal; you keep control while it plays. /butcher opens the settings.

releases.notes:
The first full release. Needs Fabric API; Mod Menu is optional. Minecraft 26.2.

## New: the Crystal Nucleus
- **Every loot bundle gets a cutscene** the moment you place the fifth crystal. Pick its style in the menu:
  - **The Vault**: a round vault door rises out of Dwarven stone, your five crystals fly into its sockets, the bolts pull
    back and the seam cycles through their colours before it lands. A plain haul tips out onto the floor; a drop worth
    1.5M or more blows the door wide.
  - **The Gauntlet**: a blocky gold gauntlet rises in, and your crystals seat into it in the order you placed them -
    the thumb first, then the knuckles. The centre stone cycles through the drops it could be, faster and faster, and
    lands on your best item. A big drop clenches the fist in a flare of its colour.
- **The big three get their own endings** in both styles:
  - **Divan's Alloy**: in the Vault, the camera dives into the Dwarven forge, where the Automaton's arm hammers the
    crystals into the Alloy. In the Gauntlet, the snap: a flashbang, ringing ears, and the world crumbles to dust.
  - **Jade Dye**: in the Vault, jade bleeds out of the door and floods everything. In the Gauntlet, the Jade Storm:
    lightning between the stones, and the world turns to jade crystal and shatters.
  - **Quick Claw**: it claws its way out through the vault door.
  - When one lands, everything behind it freezes and darkens and the drop takes the middle of the screen, with its
    name, price, odds and how many you've had.
- The loot message isn't lost: it waits and goes to chat after the cutscene. Plain hauls can be shortened or skipped.

## New: the double jackpot
- **Two jackpots in one Vanguard corpse play both their endings.** The first jackpot gets its own ending the moment it
  comes out of the ice, with the block still standing behind it - and instead of going to its slot it floats round the
  ice while you keep striking.
  - **Two Shattered Lockets** (or "Shattered Locket x2", now struck as two): the last strike shatters the block, and
  the floating Locket breaks apart too. Its pieces join the new one's in two interlocking rings that pull apart and
  snap into two Lockets side by side.
  - **A Locket and the Frostbitten Dye**: the Dye's ending drains the world to grey, but the floating Locket keeps its
  gold, drifting in and beating with the heart, and is standing there when the paint bursts.
  - Then "DOUBLE!", both names, and the two prices counting up together. Try both from the Vanguard card's "Try it".

## New: the Revenant and the Tarantula
- **The Grave** (Revenant Horror V) and **the Cocoon** (Tarantula Broodfather V), under Slayers: every kill of your own
  tier V boss plays; a tier IV only plays for its dye. Short build-up, one honest reveal.
- The big drops have their own endings: the Warden Heart's Warden climbs out of the grave, the Scythe Blade cuts the
  headstone in two, the Severed Hand, the Shard of the Shredded's claw marks, the Primordial Eye's thousand eyes, the
  Digested Mosquito, the Shriveled Wasp - and the two dyes the grandest: the Matcha Dye's Wake and the Brick Red Dye's
  Red Thread.

## New: pop-ups and the Garden
- **The Automaton**: a quick pop-up when it drops one of its six robot parts.
- **Summoning Eye**: a rift tears open and spits out a Special Zealot's eye (a bigger one for the Awakened eye).
- **The Garden**: Crop Fever's glow round the screen's edges while it lasts, a pop-up for each of its drops, and a
  pop-up when a visitor's reward is worth 5M or more (adjustable).
- Fin and Wisp moved into a new **Pop-ups** card with the Automaton and the Eye, each with its own switch, volume and
  "Try it".

## The Ledger
- **Five new chapters** - the Grave, the Cocoon, the Garden, the Automaton and the Summoning Eye - with 57 new stamps,
  many of them secret. The divider tabs run down both sides of the book.
